{"rules": ["Model consistently overestimates the 30-day terminal price by ~15-20 EUR when starting from a downtrend (e.g., Example 1 start 87 vs true end 86), indicating a mean-reversion bias that ignores recent volatility spikes.", "Forecast fails to capture immediate post-spike corrections; after a sharp rise in history (e.g., Ex 4 day 18: 89.65), the model continues its upward drift while the true outcome reverses sharply within 3-5 days.", "Sentiment history shows no predictive power for short-term direction; low sentiment values (0.00) do not correlate with price drops, suggesting the model ignores market mood as a volatility driver.", "Model exhibits significant lag in recognizing trend exhaustion; it projects linear growth even when recent history shows high frequency of reversals (e.g., Ex 2-5), failing to adjust for increased intraday noise.", "Terminal forecast error is systematic: predicted ends are consistently higher than actual ends by ~10-15 EUR, requiring a downward correction factor of roughly 12% on the 30-day projection."]
